title: Documents

tabIntro.mine: Only you can see documents here. K.AI uses them when answering you — no one else, not even administrators, can read them.
tabIntro.unit: Documents of your unit and the units above it (passed down). Unit heads also see and manage documents of their child units.
tabIntro.company: Company-wide regulations, processes and strategy. Everyone in the company can view them and K.AI uses them when answering anyone.

notice.chatHistory: Deleting a document or changing who can view it does not delete K.AI answers that already quoted it — they remain in the chat history of the person who asked.

legacy.sectionHint: Indexed before the document library existed, so there is no original file. K.AI still uses them as company documents; upload the original file to manage them fully.
legacy.explain: This document was indexed before the document library existed and has no original file: K.AI still uses it as a company document, but it cannot be downloaded or edited. Upload the original file to replace it — the old one is removed once the new one is indexed.

empty.notMemberTitle: You are not in an organization yet
empty.notMemberDescription: Documents belong to an organization and its units. Ask an administrator to add you to a unit.
empty.filteredDescription: Try removing some filters or changing the search.
empty.mineDescription: Upload your own notes and references so K.AI can answer closer to your work.
empty.unitTitle: This unit has no documents yet
empty.unitDescription: Unit heads can upload the unit regulations and job descriptions so K.AI and KPI suggestions follow the real work.
empty.companyTitle: The company has no documents yet
empty.companyDescription: Upload company regulations, processes and strategy so K.AI can quote them in answers.
empty.noUnitDescription: You do not belong to any unit with documents.
empty.folderDescription: Upload documents or create a subfolder here.

aiStatusHint.NONE: “Use for AI” is off — K.AI does not read this document.
aiStatusHint.INDEXING: Reading and adding it to the knowledge base.
aiStatusHint.UNSUPPORTED: The file has no text the AI can read (it may be a scan).

fields.title: Document name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What the document is about and who it applies to (optional)
fields.datesHint: Optional. On the review date the document managers are reminded to read it again; once expired, K.AI still reads it but says it has expired when quoting it.
fields.datesOdd: The expiry date is before the review date — check whether that was a typo.

audience.PERSONAL: Only you can view it. K.AI uses it when answering you.
audience.UNIT: Members of {{unit}} and its child units can view it; K.AI uses it when answering them.
audience.COMPANY: Everyone in the company can view it; K.AI uses it when answering anyone in the company.
audience.off: K.AI will not read this document. It is still stored for viewing and downloading.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.description: Accepts {{types}}, up to {{max}} per file. Indexing for the knowledge base runs in the background after saving.
upload.dropHint: Drag a Word, PDF, Excel, .txt or .md file here (up to {{max}})

edit.heading: Details and visibility
edit.movingToPersonal: The document will move to YOUR personal storage — only you will be able to view it.
edit.scopeChangeReindex: Changing the scope changes who can view it; the document is re-indexed for the AI under the new scope.

chunks.show_one: See what the AI reads ({{count}} chunk)
chunks.show_other: See what the AI reads ({{count}} chunks)

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.description: K.AI stops using this document immediately. It goes to the trash and can be restored within {{days}} days. Answers K.AI previously quoted from it remain in chat history.
delete.legacyDescription: K.AI stops using this document immediately. Legacy documents have no original file, so they do not go to the trash — deleting is permanent.

toast.uploaded: Uploaded — the AI is reading the document
toast.uploadFailed: The document could not be uploaded
toast.fileReplaced: File replaced — the AI is reading it again
toast.deleteFailed: The document could not be deleted
toast.legacyReplaced: Original file uploaded — the old one is removed once the new one is indexed
toast.restored: Restored — AI is reading it again
toast.versionRestored: Version restored — AI is reading it again
toast.promotionApproved: Approved — the document has been moved up
toast.convertedOnline: Converted to an online document — the old file is in the Versions tab
toast.autoConvertFailed: Uploaded, but it could not be turned into an online document — you can still view and download it.

settingsCard.title: AI assistant documents have moved to the Documents page
settingsCard.description: Manage company, unit and personal documents in one place, with original files and scope-based access. The search box below runs the K.AI retrieval with your own permissions.
settingsCard.searchPlaceholder: e.g. what reward does an employee with an A rating get?

sources.label: Sources:
sources.notFound: This document could not be opened — it may have been deleted or you no longer have access.

purge.title: Delete personal documents of {{name}}
purge.summary_one: This person has {{count}} personal document ({{size}}). You only see the count — not names or content.
purge.summary_other: This person has {{count}} personal documents ({{size}}). You only see the count — not names or content.
purge.warning: K.AI stops using these documents immediately. Original files are kept for 30 more days, then deleted. If not deleted early, the system deletes them 90 days after the account was deactivated.
purge.empty: This person has no personal documents.
purge.notDeactivated: Personal documents can only be deleted early for a paused or suspended account.
purge.failed: The personal documents could not be deleted

pageIntro: Personal, unit and company documents in one place — organized in folders, shared with the people who need them, and K.AI reads exactly what each person is allowed to see.

nav.label: Document navigation
nav.pinnedEmpty: Pin documents you use often to open them quickly from here.

folder.name: Folder name
folder.deleteDescription: Subfolders are deleted too. Documents inside go to the trash and can be restored within {{days}} days (to the root of their scope).

move.title: Move “{{title}}”
move.description: Choose a folder in the same scope. To change who can view it, change “Scope” in the document details.

intro.PERSONAL: Personal documents are visible only to you. Share to let others view and download it — and K.AI reads it when answering them.
intro.UNIT: Unit members can already view it. Share with other people or units so they can view it too — K.AI reads it when answering them.
intro.COMPANY: Everyone in the company can already view company documents. For online documents, share edit access with people who should write it with you.

share.youAreViewer: {{name}} shared this document with you — you can view and download it, but not edit it.
share.noUnits: The organization has no units to share with.
share.viaUnit: Can already view via the unit {{name}}
share.permissionHint: Editors can change the content, like Google Docs — they cannot delete, move or re-share it.
share.youAreEditor: {{name}} shared this document with you — you can view and edit its content.

versions.intro: Every time the file is replaced, the old one is kept (up to 10 versions). Restoring an old version does not lose the current one.
versions.none: No earlier versions yet — use “Replace file” to create a new version.
versions.confirmDescription: This version becomes the current one; the current file is kept in the history. K.AI will read the content again.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted documents you can manage. They can be restored within {{days}} days, after which the file is deleted permanently.
trash.emptyDescription: Deleted documents stay here for {{days}} days before being deleted permanently.
trash.confirmDescription: The file and all earlier versions are deleted immediately and cannot be restored.
trash.emptyConfirmDescription_one: Permanently delete {{count}} document and all its earlier versions. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyConfirmDescription_other: Permanently delete {{count}} documents and all their earlier versions. This cannot be undone.

home.cardUploadHint: Word, Excel, PDF… edit right away
home.cardAskHint: Answers from documents you can see

empty.recentDescription: Documents you recently opened or uploaded will appear here.
empty.ownedTitle: You have not created any documents
empty.ownedDescription: Documents you upload (personal, unit or company) will appear here.
empty.sharedTitle: Nothing has been shared with you yet
empty.sharedDescription: When someone shares a document with you or your unit, it will appear here.
empty.favoritesDescription: Click ⋯ → “Add to favorites” on a document to collect it here.

picker.title: Choose from the document library
picker.description: Choose up to {{max}} documents you can view. The files are copied here — deleting the original later does not affect them.
picker.descriptionTypes: Choose up to {{max}} documents you can view ({{types}} accepted). The files are copied here — deleting the original later does not affect them.
picker.tooMany: You can choose at most {{max}} documents here
picker.loadFailed: Could not load the document file, please try again
picker.emptyDescription: Documents you upload or can view on the Documents page will appear here.
picker.typeNotAccepted: {{name}} — this file type is not accepted here

promotion.propose: Propose to a unit / the company
promotion.dialogDescription: The document managers at the destination will review it. Once approved, the document is copied there — your copy stays as is.
promotion.targetPlaceholder: Choose a unit or the company
promotion.notePlaceholder: E.g. this process already works in our team, proposing it for the whole department
promotion.copyHint: Everyone at the destination will be able to view the copy, and K.AI uses it when answering them.
promotion.inboxIntro: Proposals to move documents to a unit or the company whose documents you manage. Approving copies the document there.
promotion.inboxEmptyDescription: When someone proposes moving a document to a place you manage, it will appear here.
promotion.mineIntro: Your proposals to move documents up and their results.
promotion.mineEmptyTitle: You have not sent any proposals
promotion.mineEmptyDescription: Open one of your documents → “Propose to a unit / the company”.
promotion.approveDescription: The document is copied as a new document at the destination (counted against its quota). You can rename the copy.
promotion.rejectDescription: {{name}} will be notified with the reason.

storage.versionsHint_one: {{count}} old file kept when files were replaced (not counted against quota)
storage.versionsHint_other: {{count}} old files kept when files were replaced (not counted against quota)
storage.topOwnersHint: Only counts and sizes are shown — no names or content of personal documents.

online.createDescription: Write right in the browser, like Lark Docs — autosaved, with version history, readable by K.AI.
online.createSheetDescription: A spreadsheet like Lark Sheets / Google Sheets — formulas, formatting, filters, sorting, multiple sheets; autosaved and readable by K.AI.

editor.conflict: Someone else has just saved a newer version of this document.
editor.leaveBlocked: Your changes are not saved yet — try saving again before leaving.
editor.aiNote: Changes are saved automatically. Saves within one editing session are merged into one version; K.AI re-reads the content a few minutes after you stop editing.
editor.markdownNotice: A .md file only keeps Markdown formatting — text colors, highlights and alignment are lost on save. Convert to an online document to keep full formatting (the .md file stays in the Versions tab).
